title: New Craft Session
prompt: A highly detailed, luxury modern two-story 3 BHK architectural bungalow with complete exterior and walkable interior geometry. Ground floor features an elevated foundation slab with entrance step risers, a covered grand portico with four square beveled support columns, a double-height central living hall with dark polished hardwood flooring, an open-concept dining area, and a master bedroom with an attached bath enclosure. A central wooden wedge-step staircase with beveled balustrade handrails connects the ground floor to the upper gallery. The first floor includes two spacious private bedrooms with sliding doorframes leading out onto cantilevered glass-railed balconies, protected by deep-set exterior overhangs and a multi-tiered hipped terracotta roof. Exterior walls feature chamfered concrete panels and large panoramic tinted glass window bays. Calibrated PBR materials throughout: high-reflectance glass (smoothness 0.95), brushed bronze fixtures (metallic 0.88, smoothness 0.75), matte masonry walls (roughness 0.82), warm polished oak planks (roughness 0.32), and soft warm-white interior ceiling LED strip emission glow.

Linked with Unity 6 (Auto-detected running engine: Unity 6 — test project). Active workspace synchronized & ready.

Autonomous remediation applied: generated edge bevel chamfers and calibrated fixture seating in Unity.
Configured calibrated PBR materials and soft emissive shader on Ceiling_LED_Strip.
✓ SAM 3.1 verified all 4 angles: 0 defects remaining. Silhouette, bevels, and PBR illumination verified (Score: 96.8%, Status: VERIFIED_PERFECT).
Finalized AAA game-ready Luxury Modern Two-Story 3 BHK Bungalow in Unity 6 (Unity URP Prefab).
